title: Mikal Bridges Has Something To Say To Hornets Bench, And Charles Lee Clearly Doesn't Like It [VIDEO] - NewsBreak
text:
By Kenny Nosay ,
1 hours ago
Mikal Bridges and Charles Lee (Photo by @NBA_NewYork/X) The NBA Cup game between the New York Knicks and the Charlotte Hornets had little hype. It was clear that unless the Hornets played with some urgency, the Knicks would likely secure an easy win. And indeed, it was a blowout win for NY. Well, Jalen Brunson’s head might have hurt a little after the win, though.
Interestingly, during the game, Knicks forward Mikal Bridges decided to talk some trash to the crowd and the opposing bench after converting a layup off a steal. His taunting did not escape Hornets coach Charles Lee, which eventually led to a brief exchange after a timeout was called on the floor.
Not entirely sure what was said between them, but Bridges might have irked Lee with his actions. The Hornets were down for most of the contest, which may have contributed to Lee’s frustrations.
With the Knicks’ win, they are now five games over .500 and improve their positioning in the Eastern Conference.
The Knicks Remain Committed In This Group New York Knicks logo (Image Credits: Imagn) With the East a bit open, the Knicks are one of the teams to watch out for in their conference. While they haven’t added much talent in the offseason, the team remains committed to their current core of Jalen Brunson, Karl-Anthony Towns, Mikal Bridges, OG Anunoby, and Josh Hart.
As a testament to this, Coach Mike Brown even lauded both Bridges and Brunson for taking a pay cut in order for this roster to stay mostly intact, not just now but in the future as well. However, will all of their sacrifices pay off in the long run? The Detroit Pistons and the Toronto Raptors are surging right now.
It appears that the Knicks will face some competition when the playoffs arrive in 2026.
